rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, proj_sx=0.01, proj_sy=0.3, proj_sr=0.0005, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-2, ONE-KNOB change vs iter-1: projection-domain BF sigmas swapped from Wagner-abdomen defaults (proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02) to the breast-tuned (proj_sx=0.01, proj_sy=0.3, proj_sr=0.0005). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-1 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=img_n_bf=1, 6 trainable BF params, seed=42). FAILURE MODE addressed: iter-1 hr=0 (val_score 0.9720, PSNR 38.17 vs LD-FBP baseline 39.68 - UNDER baseline). solver_dual_ddomain_bilateral_n2i.md Weaknesses + Hints: the Wagner-abdomen proj sigmas (proj_sx=1.0 -> radial blur after FBP; proj_sy=2.0 -> angular over-smoothing) are TOO AGGRESSIVE for 128-view sparse breast-CT - they radially blur the sparse-view reconstruction on top of the existing streaks, smearing fibroglandular detail. The breast-tuned values (proven sensible from breast-ct-claude-agentic-dual-domain-bf-search-20260521-01) shrink proj_sx to near-identity (0.01, avoids radial blur), keep modest angular interpolation (proj_sy=0.3, mild help for sparse views), and tighten the range sigma (proj_sr=0.0005 << data range, preserves the breast/air attenuation edge in the sinogram). HYPOTHESIS: with the proj-domain BF near-identity + edge-preserving instead of radially blurring, per-image bilateral N2I stops smearing the FBP and recovers PSNR toward (ideally above) the 39.68 LD-FBP baseline, lifting hr off 0. WALL: identical step budget to iter-1 (warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800), which completed in 241 s - far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged.
